figures.caption: Fig. 1. The main ideas behind CLF guided RL. A CLF is designed offline and used in an RL/optimal control problem as the reward/cost. Then the optimal policy, π∗ is applied to the system resulting in provable exponential stability and in stable humanoid locomotion.

Fig. 6. CLF-RL applied to a humanoid robot. Rather than tracking a single point, the CLF tracks a reference trajectory which forms a periodic orbit in the state space. We plot the tracking of the position and velocity of the pelvis and the left hip pitch joint. We also plot the discounted reward and normed error on foot impact to show the discrete step-to-step system’s convergence. The robot starts from standing still and converges into the walking orbit.
